caption:
Rabbi Berel Mochkin of Montreal—a true, legendary Chabad Chossid of a bygone era. Prays for hours on end while meditating on G-d, and has selflessly helped countless people in countless ways as emissary, Shliach, of the Lubavitcher Rebbe.

​Pure holiness.

​Truly grateful to G-d for the privilege of sitting in his presence.
